howto.title: How to Play
howto.1: Roll the dice (click the button or press Space) and your token moves that many tiles.
howto.2: Land on the foot of a ladder 🪜 → climb to its top.
howto.3: Land on a snake's head 🐍 → slide down to its tail.
howto.4: Roll a 6 → roll again. Three 6s in a row → turn forfeited.
howto.5: First to reach tile 100 wins. Overshoot and your token bounces back (can be turned off).
howto.6: Rotate the camera by dragging, zoom with scroll / pinch.
hud.hold: Hold the button / Space, release when the bar is full in the green zone = better dice odds!
hud.holdShort: Hold, then release in the green zone
howto.7: Hold the ROLL button (or Space) to fill the power bar, then release when it is full in the green zone — a perfect throw raises the odds of a high number. Hold too long and the power is lost.
